summary: Frontend-only verification (iteration 7) of (1) Wallet Recent top-ups history and (2) Points Redemption at checkout for buyer@nameword.local. Both features fully functional.

use_max_click.note: Order fully covered by points so pay button switches to points-only label as designed.

points_redemption.slider_manual_move: Programmatic input event on native range didn't propagate to React state in the test (likely React onChange path); however Use max + Clear both mutate state correctly and slider position visually updates via Use max. Not a functional bug — main agent may verify with real user drag if desired.

critical_code_review_comments: Cart route is served at /cart (not /checkout/cart as stated in the request). /checkout/cart on an empty cart redirects to /. Route works; just a doc mismatch.
Console warning: 'Missing environment variables: [VITE_API_KEY]'. Non-blocking but noisy — either remove the warn or set a dummy value in preview build.
seed_data_creation: None. Random domain names (cartchk*.com) were searched only; NO order was placed (final pay/crypto-pay buttons were not clicked).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cart route is /cart. To reach it, add a domain from /domains via [data-testid=exact-match-add-button], then click 'Open full cart (nameservers & reward points)' in the cart drawer. All rewards testids in CartPage.jsx work as documented. Buyer account had 2187.2 pts and $50 wallet; max redeemable is capped at 1950 pts (= $39 = full order for a $39 .com), which is why pay button flips to 'Pay with 1950 points' after Use max. Do NOT click cart-pay-button or cart-pay-crypto-button.
